system.description:
TAIL LASH

Prerequisites Large Size, Tail Attack

Trigger A creature within reach of the dragon companions tail attack takes a Strike action.

Action Reaction

The dragon companion lashes out at the creature with its tail making Strike with a -2-circumstance penalty.

Partly automated: Use, when a creature in reach of the tail Strikes (target it first): spends the reaction and makes a tail Strike at −2 circumstance. Needs a Large dragon with its Tail Slap (Base +10); the trigger is the table's to call.
